theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e y : Euclid P) (s : ℝ), 0 < s → s ≤ 1 / 4 → ‖Q.starProjection y‖ ^ 2 = inner ℝ y a ^ 2 + inner ℝ y e ^ 2 → 0 < inner ℝ y a → |‖y‖ - 1| < s → |Real.arctan (inner ℝ y e / inner ℝ y a)| < s → ‖y - Q.starProjection y‖ < s * ‖y‖ → 1 / 2 < inner ℝ y a ∧ ‖y‖ < 5 / 4
